name: Jehoshaphat
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy

points: The list of his officers follows: Joab over the host, Jehoshaphat the recorder, Zadok and Abimelech the priests, Shavsha the scribe, and Benaiah over the Cherethites and Pelethites.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 18: The Victories of King David
